when_outcome.success: Home the long way, dry, and only a little later than promised.
when_outcome.partial: Ash arrives wet, short of breath, and short of a card or two.
when_outcome.walk_away: The long way round becomes the very long way round.

when_outcome.success: The far bank, on all four feet, with the fog behind him where it belongs.
when_outcome.partial: He makes the bank. Most of him makes the bank.
when_outcome.walk_away: Ash turns back. The Mere does not mind waiting; that is its whole character.
